newsitem.title: USA: Home State stake held by Marvin Schwartz.
newsitem.headline: Home State stake held by Marvin Schwartz.

text.p: Marvin Schwartz, general partner of the New York limited partnership Neuberger & Berman, said Thursday he holds a 6.7 percent stake in Home State Holdings, or 379,000 common shares.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, Schwartz said his latest transactions include the purchase of 247,000 common shares between November 29, 1996, and January 30, 1997, at prices ranging from $7.375 to $8 per share.
Schwartz said he holds the stake for investment purposes.

Home State, based in Red Bank, New Jersey, is a property and casualty insurance holding company engaged primarily in providing personal and commercial auto insurance through its operating subsidiaries in New Jersey.
